subject: Novus Commerce: onboarding for e-invoice & remittance routing
messages:
From: Samantha Lewis <samantha@novus-commerce.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, AP Team <ap@novus-commerce.com>
Cc: Trevor Singh <trevor@novus-commerce.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding - API/e-invoice and remit details

Hi Ava / Redwood team,

Thanks for agreeing to work with Novus. We're ready to register Redwood as a vendor in our procurement system but need a handful of items to finish onboarding and enable auto-ingest of invoices into our AP workflow. Can you confirm the following and send what you have?

- Completed vendor onboarding packet (we need legal entity name, remit-to bank, W-9 or W-8 if applicable).
- Primary remit method preferred (ACH or wire + bank details).
- Does Redwood support UBL 2.1/PEPPOL or do you prefer SFTP/API webhook for invoice delivery? If API, we need OAuth/MTLS certs details.
- PO matching requirements: do you require PO# on the first line, line-level matching, tax handling?
- Any vendor code/ID you want us to set in our system.

We can accept test invoices in UBL format; please attach a sample. Also note Novus requires a vendor record before issuing the first PO.

Thanks,
Samantha Lewis
Sr. AP Manager
Novus Commerce

Attachment: Novus-vendor-requirements-v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha@novus-commerce.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - API/e-invoice and remit details

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the checklist. Attached is our vendor onboarding packet and W-9 for Redwood Inference. Quick answers below and Laura will follow with the official AP mapping:

- Packet/W-9: attached (W9-Redwood-Inference.pdf, Novus-AP-onboarding-form.pdf).
- Remit: ACH preferred for US. Bank remit details included on page 2 of the packet; we can also support wire if needed.
- E-invoice: We support both SFTP drops (preferred for bulk) and a webhook-based invoice API. We generate UBL 2.1 by default and can produce PEPPOL-compliant payloads on request.
- PO matching: PO# must be included on the invoice header. We support line-level matching; please include line-item SKU or description and quantity. Tax: Redwood does not collect VAT in the US — provide TIN on the W-9 and include tax fields if your system requires them.
- Vendor code: we do not have a preferred vendor code to force in your system; if you want to set one, suggest "RWINF-<shortid>".

Laura (cc'd) will send the mandatory PO field list and sandbox endpoint details. Marcus can take the cert exchange and test invoice run. If you want to set up a short call next week to walk sandbox steps, happy to schedule.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: W9-Redwood-Inference.pdf, Novus-AP-onboarding-form.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha@novus-commerce.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Novus AP mapping & mandatory invoice fields

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the note. Attaching our completed vendor packet for your records (Novus-AP-onboarding-form.pdf). Below are the mandatory fields Novus must provide on each invoice for automated PO matching in our AR system:

Mandatory header fields:
- Vendor legal name (exact match to vendor record)
- Invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date (ISO 8601)
- PO number (Novus PO#)
- Total amount and currency

Line-level fields (if PO contains line items):
- Line number or SKU
- Quantity
- Unit price
- Line total

Other requirements:
- Format: UBL 2.1 XML preferred. If you deliver via SFTP, name the file <NOVUS_PO>_<INVOICE_NUM>_<YYYYMMDD>.xml
- For API/webhook: please include an HMAC-SHA256 signature header (we'll provide the shared secret in the sandbox exchange).
- Bank remit: we prefer ACH (routing + account). If wire, include intermediary bank info.
- Tax: Since Novus is US-based, include tax amounts if applicable; include a TIN field in the vendor record.

Sandbox & testing:
- SFTP host: sftp.redwood-internal.test (credentials to follow in separate secure message).
- API endpoint: https://sandbox-api.redwood.ai/ap/invoices/receive
- Please send a test invoice (we accepted your Test-invoice-UBL.xml) and we will confirm parsing and PO matching.

Questions for you:
- Can Novus include 'supplier_reference' in the UBL extension? It helps route to the right cost-center.
- Preferred payment terms (Net 30/45/60) so we can set the invoice aging.

I'll follow with the production submission checklist and our vendor-numbering convention after successful sandbox validation.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
AP Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Novus-AP-onboarding-form.pdf

From: Samantha Lewis <samantha@novus-commerce.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus AP mapping & mandatory invoice fields

Laura —

Thanks, that's very clear. I attached a test UBL (Test-invoice-UBL.xml) that mirrors how our TMS exports invoices. A few items:

- We currently push invoices via SFTP to customer endpoints; we can add an API integration but will need a short window for our security team to approve cert exchange.
- Regarding 'supplier_reference', we can add a custom extension in UBL; will include in the next test.
- Payment terms: default Net 30; if Redwood offers earlier payment discounts please advise.
- For W-9/tax: attached W9 for Redwood, looks good.

One more question — does Redwood support PO-less invoices for one-off services if we include a work-order reference? Novus sometimes issues tix without PO.

Regards,
Samantha
Sr. AP Manager
Novus Commerce

Attachments: Test-invoice-UBL.xml

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lewis <samantha@novus-commerce.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus AP mapping & mandatory invoice fields

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the sample. I validated the UBL file in our sandbox and parsing looks good but we saw two items to adjust for perfect line-level matching:

1) Include the PO number both in the header (cbc:ID) and as an ext:SupplierReference element so our matcher can handle mixed-format exports.
2) Use ISO currency codes (USD) in cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode.

Integration options we support (pick one):
- SFTP drop: recommended for bulk. Filename convention: NOVUS_<INVOICE_NUM>_<YYYYMMDD>.xml. Once you provide a test file to sftp.redwood-internal.test, reply and we'll ACK/NAK back to the same path.
- API webhook: POST JSON with Base64-encoded UBL payload to https://sandbox-api.redwood.ai/ap/invoices/webhook. Use HMAC-SHA256 signature header x-rw-signature. We'll provide shared secret during cert exchange.
- PEPPOL/AS2: we can accept PEPPOL BIS3 envelopes; we would need endpoint cert and sender ID.

PO-less invoices: we can accept them if you include a 'work_order' reference and the AP team manually approves in our portal. For now please route those through ap@redwood.ai with subject "PO-less: <work_order>" so the ticket creates.

Next steps:
- If you confirm SFTP, I'll send credentials in a separate secure message and coordinate a 30-minute test window next week for cert exchange and a trial drop.
- If API is preferred, we can do a quick MTLS cert exchange and run the webhook test.

Feel free to schedule a 30-minute validation call here: https://calendly.com/marcuslin/redwood-ap-integration

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
